info.title: Waslah WhatsApp CRM API
info.description:
REST API for the Waslah WhatsApp CRM. One business phone number, no multi-tenancy.

## Authentication
Call `POST /v1/auth/login` with email and password to get a JWT, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request. Tokens expire after 12 hours.

## Roles
- **admin** — everything, including user management.
- **supervisor** — manages inboxes, labels, pipelines and all conversations.
- **agent** — works conversations in inboxes they are members of, or assigned to them.

## Conventions
- Lists are cursor-paginated: `?limit=50&cursor=<opaque>` → `{ data, nextCursor }`. Max `limit` is 100.
- Errors always return `{ error: { code, message, details } }`. Validation failures are `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.fields`.
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC. Ids are MongoDB ObjectIds (24 hex chars).

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
Returns a JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request. Accounts are created by an admin (`POST /v1/users`) or the `create-admin` script.

**Auth:** none (public).

get.description:
Rejects with 401 if the account behind the token was disabled or deleted.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

400.description: Invalid request — VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_PASSWORD (current password is wrong)

patch.description:
Change name, role, status, or reset the password (no current password needed). Admins cannot change their own role or status.

**Roles:** admin.

get.description:
Managers see all inboxes; agents see only the inboxes they are members of.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

patch.description:
Set `isDefault: true` to make this the inbox for new conversations.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

delete.description:
The inbox must have no conversations and must not be the default.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

delete.summary: Remove a member from an inbox

get.description:
Newest activity first. Agents only see conversations in their inboxes or assigned to them. `assignee` accepts `me`, `unassigned`, or a user id.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `?cursor=` to get the next page; null on the last page

post.description:
Managers may assign any inbox member. Agents may only claim an unassigned conversation (`assigneeId` = their own id) or release their own (`assigneeId: null`).

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

Resolving clears the unread count. Reopening fails if the contact already has another active conversation.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

post.summary: Move a conversation to another inbox
post.description:
The assignee is cleared if they are not a member of the new inbox.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

delete.summary: Remove a label from a conversation

post.description:
Sends via the WhatsApp Cloud API. Only allowed within 24 hours of the last customer message (`WINDOW_CLOSED` otherwise). The first agent to reply to an unassigned conversation is auto-assigned. If WhatsApp rejects the message it is stored with `status: failed` and a 502 is returned.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

delete.description:
Also removes the label from every conversation and deal.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

post.description:
Omit `stages` to get the default stages.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

delete.description:
The pipeline must have no deals.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

get.description:
Stages in order with open-deal count, total value and probability-weighted value.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

post.description:
Appended at the end of the board.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

put.description:
`stageIds` must contain every stage of the pipeline exactly once, in the new order.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

delete.description:
The stage must have no deals, and a pipeline keeps at least one stage.

**Roles:** admin, supervisor.

get.description:
Most recently updated first.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `?cursor=` to get the next page; null on the last page

post.description:
`stageId` defaults to the pipeline’s first stage; `ownerId` defaults to the caller.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.

404.description: NOT_FOUND, NOT_FOUND (pipeline, stage, contact or conversation)

patch.description:
Send `null` for `ownerId` or `expectedCloseDate` to clear them.

**Roles:** any authenticated user.
